title: Implement quest system

%Quest{id, name, description, objectives: [%Objective{}], rewards, status}

Objective types:
- :talk - Talk to NPC
- :kill - Defeat enemy
- :get_item - Obtain item
- :go_to - Visit location

Functions:
- accept_quest(player_state, quest_id) - Start tracking quest
- update_progress(player_state, event) - Auto-update on events
- complete_objective(player_state, quest_id, objective_id)
- is_complete?(player_state, quest_id) - All objectives done
- turn_in_quest(player_state, quest_id) - Claim rewards
- get_active_quests(player_state) - List in-progress quests

title: Design combat system data model
description: Design the combat state structure: combatants, turn order, actions available, health/stats tracking. Consider how it integrates with existing PlayerGameState.
design:
Combat state stored in socket assigns (not DB - temporary state). Structure:
- combat: %{enemy_id, enemy, player_turn: true, turn_count: 1, log: []}
- Actions: attack, defend (reduce incoming damage), flee (chance-based)
- Enemy has combatant component with health, stats, rewards
- Combat ends when either side reaches 0 HP or player flees

title: Implement equipment system
description:
File: lib/exmud/demo_game/systems/equipment.ex

Slots: :weapon, :armor, :accessory

Functions:
- equip(player_state, item_id) - Move item from inventory to slot
- unequip(player_state, slot) - Move item from slot to inventory
- get_equipped(player_state) - Get all equipped items
- get_total_bonuses(player_state) - Sum all equipment stat bonuses

Stat calculation:
- Base stats from player_state.stats
- Add equipment bonuses
- Final attack = (str * 2) + weapon_bonus
- Final defense = sta + armor_bonus
- Final health = sta * 10

UI: Show equipment in inventory panel, equip/unequip actions
